summary: Explains projections are evaluated lazily after the task completes (order-independent; not available within non-looped tasks), loops need default for the first item, and registered variables live in memory only for the current run on that host.
questions: Can registered variables be cached between playbook runs?
Are registered variables available in later plays?

answer_card.title: When projections are evaluated and how long registered vars last
answer_card.answer_md:
Projections are evaluated **after** the task completes, so definition order doesn't matter, and for non-looped tasks they aren't available within the task itself. In loops, earlier items' projections are available, but use `default` for the first iteration.

Registered variables live **in memory** on that host for the rest of the current run (including later plays). They can't be cached for future runs.
